# Introduction

This document includes the differential gene expression analysis (DEA) for the gene, transcript and exon expression of the postmortem human brain (dorsolateral prefrontal cortex - Brodmann area 9) samples coming from patients with schizophrenia (SCZ), bipolar disorder (BPD) and major depression disorder (MDD) as well as healthy controls (CTL). We decided to combine all diagnosis (SCZ, BPD and MDD) to one case (CASE) for power reasons. We did not find any differentially expressed genes, transcripts or exons using the diagnosis as single cases. Following steps are performed for each level (gene, transcript and exon):

1. Load data
2. DEA for diagnosis correcting for all covariates
3. DEA using the polygenic risk score instead of the diagnosis (also correcting for covariates)

Below you can find the list of packages that are required by the workflow. 
```{r, echo = F}
# General Bioconductor packages
library(biomaRt)

# Data analysis
library(oligo)
library(limma)  # for differential expression

# Formatting packages
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(rtracklayer)
library(plyr)

# Color palettes
library(RColorBrewer)
library(viridis)

# Packages for plotting 
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(grid)
library(ggrepel)  # for volcanoplot
```

# Functions

As we have to do several analysis multiple times, we will put these into functions to reduce the lines of code. 
```{r definition, echo=F}
# function to load the PRS all score file, change the colnames into right order and return only IID and 0.01 PRS
GetPRS <- function(filename){
  all_scores <- suppressWarnings(fread(filename, stringsAsFactors = F))
  # set colnames right 
  names <- colnames(all_scores)[-1] # remove first colname and save all others
  all_scores$`1` <- NULL # remove last column with NAs
  colnames(all_scores) <- names # set right colnames
  # return only IID and PRS for 0.01
  score <- all_scores[, c("IID", "0.01")]
  return(score)  
}

# function to run the linear model (limma) using the normal model for genes only 
RunLimma <- function(design, summary){
  # get top DE genes
  fit <- lmFit(summary, design)
  fit2 <- eBayes(fit)
  return(fit2)
}

# functions to generate result tables
# 1. get top hits
# 2. rename columns
# 3. separate merged gene symbols and remove duplicated rows: necessary as exactly the same gene symbols (and IDs for transcript/exon level) were merged together. This happens because:
# on gene level: one of the transripts of the gene is an uncharacterized protein and therefore leads to two different gene ensembl IDs
# on transcript/exon level: two or more transcripts/exons have the exact same expression values and were merged together as also done for their gene symbols and IDs. Usually these gene symbols and IDs are just duplicates and we need to remove these for further analysis (e.g. new FDR correction). The merged transcript/exon IDs we will leave merged.
# 4. save the resulting table into an output file
GenerateResultTableGene <- function(fit, variable, file){
  top_hits <- topTable(fit, coef = variable, adjust = "BH", number = Inf)
  print(top_hits[1:2, ])
  print(paste0("log2FC range: ", round(min(top_hits$logFC), 2), " until ", round(max(top_hits$logFC), 2)))
  colnames(top_hits) <- c("Ensembl Gene ID", "Location", "Gene Symbol", "logFC", "Average Expression", "t-statistic", "p-value", "FDR estimate", "B coefficient")
  top_hits <- unique(separate_rows(top_hits, `Ensembl Gene ID`, sep = "\\|"))
  top_hits <- unique(separate_rows(top_hits, `Gene Symbol`, sep = "\\|"))
  write.table(top_hits, file = paste0("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/03_DEA_results/", file), sep = "\t", row.names = F)
  return(top_hits)
}

  print(top_hits[1:2, ])

  colnames(top_hits) <- c("Ensembl Transcript ID", "Location", "Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol", "logFC", "Average Expression", "t-statistic", "p-value", "FDR estimate", "B coefficient")
  top_hits <- unique(separate_rows(top_hits, `Ensembl Gene ID`, sep = "\\|"))
  top_hits <- unique(separate_rows(top_hits, `Gene Symbol`, sep = "\\|"))

  return(top_hits)
}
GenerateResultTableExon <- function(fit, variable, file){
  top_hits <- topTable(fit, coef = variable, adjust = "BH", number = Inf)
  print(top_hits[1:2, ])
  print(paste0("log2FC range: ", round(min(top_hits$logFC), 2), " until ", round(max(top_hits$logFC), 2)))
  colnames(top_hits) <- c("Ensembl Exon ID", "Location", "Ensembl Transcript ID", "Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol", "logFC", "Average Expression", "t-statistic", "p-value", "FDR estimate", "B coefficient")
  top_hits <- unique(separate_rows(top_hits, `Ensembl Gene ID`, sep = "\\|"))

  write.table(top_hits, file = paste0("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/03_DEA_results/", file), sep = "\t", row.names = F)
  return(top_hits)
}

# function to generate a vulcano plot for differentially expressed genes
GenerateVolcanoPlot <- function(fit, variable, file) {
  # get all hits
  hits <- topTable(fit, coef = variable, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
  total <- nrow(hits)
  # get first hit after FDR 10% for drawing a p-value threshold line
  index <- if(length(which(hits$adj.P.Val < 0.1)) == 0) 0 else which(hits$adj.P.Val < 0.1)
  threshold <- hits[index[length(index)] + 1, "P.Value"]
  ### volcano plot ###
  # label only significant hits (if more than 10)
  g <- ggplot(hits, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value))) + 
    theme_bw(base_size = 22) + 
    geom_point() + 
    xlim(-2, 2) + 
    ylim(0, 6) +
    xlab(bquote(~Log[2]~ "fold change")) +
    ylab(bquote(~-Log[10]~ italic(P))) +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank()) +
    labs(caption = paste0("Total variables: ", total)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(threshold), linetype = "dashed")
 if(length(index) >= 10){
    g + geom_point(data = hits[index, ], aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value)), colour = "red2", size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(data = hits[index[1:10], ], aes(label = gene_name), colour = "red2")
  # else: label hit genes (if some are found) purple and following genes green until a maximum of 10 genes is labeled
  } else if(length(index) == 0) {
    g + geom_text_repel(data = hits[1:10, ], aes(label = gene_name))
  } else {
    g + geom_point(data = hits[index, ], aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value)), colour = "red2", size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(data = hits[index, ], aes(label = gene_name), colour = "red2") +
    geom_point(data = hits[(length(index) + 1):10, ], aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value)), size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(data = hits[(length(index) + 1):10, ], aes(label = gene_name))
  }
  g
  ggsave(paste0("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/04_figures/", file), width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")
}

# function to plot all differentially expressed hits for the different covariates corrected for all other covariates as a vertical barplot
GenerateVerticalBarplotOfDiffExprHits <- function(design, fit, from, to, plot_name){
  # Get padj values for all different covariates
  nc <- ncol(design) - 1
  limma_res_fc <- topTable(fit, adjust = "BH", sort.by = "none", number = Inf)
  limma_res_padj <- limma_res_fc[, from:(to + nc)]
  for (i in 1:nc){
    limma_res_padj[, i] = topTable(fit, adjust = "BH", sort.by = "none", number = Inf, coef = i + 1)[, "adj.P.Val"]
    if(i == nc){
      limma_res_padj$`Ensembl Gene ID` = topTable(fit, adjust = "BH", sort.by = "none", number = Inf, coef = i + 1)[, "gene_id"]
    }
  }
  limma_res_padj <- limma_res_padj[, -c(length(limma_res_padj) - 1)] # remove SV1
  colnames(limma_res_padj) <- c("Diagnosis", "Age", "Sex", "pH", "PMI", "RIN", "RIN2", "Suicide", "Type_of_Death1", "Type_of_Death2", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "Ensembl Gene ID") # "Gene Symbol", "Ensembl Gene ID")
  limma_res_padj$Type_of_Death <- (limma_res_padj$Type_of_Death1 + limma_res_padj$Type_of_Death2) / 2
  limma_res_padj <- limma_res_padj[, c("Diagnosis", "Age", "Sex", "pH", "PMI", "RIN", "RIN2", "Suicide", "Type_of_Death", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "Ensembl Gene ID")]# "Gene Symbol", "Ensembl Gene ID")]
  # unmerge Gene Ensembl IDs at their vertical dash "|"
  limma_res_padj <- unique(separate_rows(limma_res_padj, `Ensembl Gene ID`, sep = "\\|")) 
  # change data.frame into data.table to get the minimal adjusted p-value for each unique Ensembl Gene IDs (some can be found multipe times!!)
  limma_res_padj <- as.data.table(limma_res_padj)
  limma_res_padj <- limma_res_padj[, lapply(.SD, min), by = 'Ensembl Gene ID']
  # check, how many padj values are < 0.10
  limma_res_padj_0.1 <- apply(limma_res_padj[, -1], 2, function(x) sum(x < 0.1))
  limma_res_plot <- data.frame(sort(limma_res_padj_0.1, decreasing = T))
  # vertical barplot with ggplot2
  ggplot(limma_res_plot, aes(y = limma_res_plot$sort.limma_res_padj_0.1..decreasing...T., x = reorder(row.names(limma_res_plot), sort.limma_res_padj_0.1..decreasing...T.))) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 22)) +
    ylab("# significant hits") +
    xlab("") +
    geom_text(size = 7, aes(label = limma_res_plot$sort.limma_res_padj_0.1..decreasing...T.), nudge_y = 120, colour = "dimgray") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.01))
  ggsave(paste0("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/04_figures/", plot_name))
  return(limma_res_plot)
}

# function to recalculate the p-value and fdr for transcripts and exons based on gene level (Ensmebl Gene ID NOT Symbol!!): load the result table, get the smallest p-value for a gene (Ensembl Gene ID), calculate new fdr using the genes smallest p-values and gene number as background
GetExprWithSmallestP <- function(input, summaries){
  res <- fread(paste0("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/03_DEA_results/", input), header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
  # get the rows with the lowest p-value per gene ID
  min_pval <- res[ , .SD[which.min(`p-value`)], by = `Ensembl Gene ID`]
  # get all transcript IDs with lowest p-value per gene ID
  index <- which(rownames(exprs(summaries)) %in% as.character(c(min_pval[, 2])[[1]]))
  # reduce transcript/exon_summaries to these transcripts/exons
  summaries <- summaries[c(index), ]
  dim(summaries)
  return(summaries)
}
```


# Load data

## Microarray expression

Now, we will load the normalized and batch corrected microarray data summarized to gene, transcript and exon level. 
```{r, echo = F}
# Import RMA corrected and annotated Affymetrix microarray data on gene level (from probesets)
load("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/01_RData_Files/7_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_probeset_summaries_filtered_batch_corrected_SVA_gene_summaries_annotated.RData")
exprs(gene_summaries) <- as.matrix(exprs(gene_summaries))
dim(gene_summaries)

# Import RMA corrected and annotated Affymetrix microarray data on transcript level
load("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/01_RData_Files/7_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_probeset_summaries_filtered_batch_corrected_SVA_transcript_summaries_annotated.RData")
exprs(transcript_summaries) <- as.matrix(exprs(transcript_summaries))
dim(transcript_summaries)

# Import RMA corrected and annotated Affymetrix microarray data on exon level
load("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/01_RData_Files/7_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_probeset_summaries_filtered_batch_corrected_SVA_exon_summaries_annotated.RData")
```

## Polygenic risk scores

Then, we load the polygenic risk scores generated with PRSice-2 on the attention deficite hyperactivity disorder (ADHD-2017), autism spectrum disorders (ASD-2019), bipolar disorder (BPD-2018), body mass index (BMI-2015), cross-disorder (CDG1-2013, CDG2-2018), educational attainment (EA-2018), body height (HE-2014), intelligence (IN-2018), major depression disorder (MDD1-2012, MDD2-2018, MDD3-2019) and schizophrenia (SCZ2-2014) GWAS summary statistic files. # Differential Gene Expression Analysis

Now, we calculate the differentially expressed genes, transcripts and exons using a linear mixed model (limma package) correcting for all the covariates. We will also generate output tables and vulcano plots for all results.

## Gene level

### Diagnosis with normal model

First, we run the linear model with correction for all covariates and generate the result table. 
```{r, echo = F}
# generate design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ Dx + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + SV1, pData)
# differential expression analysis (limma)
fit <- RunLimma(design, gene_summaries)
# result tables
top_hits <- GenerateResultTableGene(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file =  "1.1_diff_expr_genes_for_diagnosis.csv")
top_hits_age <- GenerateResultTableGene(fit, variable = "Age", file =  "1.1_diff_expr_genes_for_age.csv")
top_hits_ph <- GenerateResultTableGene(fit, variable = "pH", file =  "1.1_diff_expr_genes_for_ph.csv")
top_hits_pmi <- GenerateResultTableGene(fit, variable = "PMI", file =  "1.1_diff_expr_genes_for_pmi.csv")
top_hits_c2 <- GenerateResultTableGene(fit, variable = "C2", file =  "1.1_diff_expr_genes_for_pc2.csv")
top_hits_c1 <- GenerateResultTableGene(fit, variable = "C1", file =  "1.1_diff_expr_genes_for_pc1.csv")
# volcano plot
GenerateVolcanoPlot(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file = "1.1_volcano_plot_diff_expr_genes_for_diagnosis.pdf")
```

We can find `r length(top_hits[top_hits$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"])` hits for diagnosis, `r length(top_hits_age[top_hits_age$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"])` hits for age, `r length(top_hits_ph[top_hits_ph$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"])` hits for pH, `r length(top_hits_pmi[top_hits_pmi$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"])` hits for PMI and `r length(top_hits_c2[top_hits_c2$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"])` hits for the second ancestry principal component (PC2).  

Now we generate a barplot including all significantly differentially expressed genes for each covariates of the model (corrected for all the other covariates in the model). 
```{r, echo = F}
# generate vertical barplot
limma_res_gene <- GenerateVerticalBarplotOfDiffExprHits(design, fit, from = 4, to = 3, plot_name = "1.1_barplot_significant_DEA_hits_genes.pdf")
rm(design, fit)
```

### Diagnosis with sex and diagnosis interaction model

Adding (Dx*Sex) to the model.
```{r, echo = F}
# generate design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ Dx + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + SV1 + (Sex * Dx), pData)
# differential expression analysis (limma)
fit <- RunLimma(design, gene_summaries)
# result table
top_hits <- GenerateResultTableGene(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file =  "1.2_diff_expr_genes_for_diagnosis_with_sex_dx_interaction.csv")
# volcano plot
GenerateVolcanoPlot(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file = "1.2_volcano_plot_diff_expr_genes_for_diagnosis_with_sex_dx_interaction.pdf")
```

We can find `r length(top_hits[top_hits$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"])` hits for diagnosis. The hit has the gene name: `r top_hits[top_hits$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"]`. For this hit gene, we will plot the residuals of sex vs. diagnosis as this gene infers a difference between these two covariates:
```{r, echo = F}
# generate design matrix
design_res <- model.matrix(~ Dx + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + SV1, pData)
# fit model
fit_res <- lmFit(gene_summaries, design_res)
# get residuals
res <- residuals.MArrayLM(fit_res, exprs(gene_summaries))
# generate boxplot with case vs control for male and female samples of the hit gene (TRIM10)
trim10 <- res[rownames(res) == "ENSG00000204613.6", ]
trim10 <- t(t(as.data.frame(trim10)))
trim10 <- merge(trim10, pData[, c("ShortName", "Dx", "Sex")], by.x = "row.names", by.y = "ShortName", all.x = T)
trim10$DxSex <- paste0(trim10$Dx, trim10$Sex)
pdf("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/04_figures/1.2_boxplot_TRIM10_diff_expr_genes_for_diagnosis_with_sex_dx_interaction.pdf", width = 7, height = 6)
ggplot(trim10, aes(Sex, trim10, fill = Dx)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Female", "Male")) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 22), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = viridis(3), labels = c("Controls", "Cases")) + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) + 
  ggtitle("TRIM10") +
  ylab("Gene expression") + 
  xlab("Sex") + 
  labs(fill = "Diagnosis")
dev.off()
# p-value females
females <- trim10[trim10$Sex == "F",]
case <- females[females$Dx == "CASE",]
control <- females[females$Dx == "CTL",]
t.test(case$trim10, control$trim10) # p-value = 0.01022
# p-value males
males <- trim10[trim10$Sex == "M",]
case <- males[males$Dx == "CASE",]
control <- males[males$Dx == "CTL",]
t.test(case$trim10, control$trim10) # p-value = 0.05302
# remove unnecessary data
rm(design, fit, design_res, fit_res, res, trim10, females, males, case, control)
```

### PRS with normal model

Now, we use the polygenic risk scores based on GWAS summary statistics instead of the diagnosis as input. As the PRS is a continuous (numeric) covariate and diagnosis is a categorical (CASE/CTL) covariate the fold change/log2 fold change (logFC) can not be calculated correctly, therefore, generating volcano plots does not make sense for PRS based differentially expressed analyses (DEA). We will use the PRSs based on the GWAS of following disorders: ADHD-2017, ASD-2019, BPD-2018, BMI-2015, CDG1-2013, CDG2-2018, EA-2018 HE-2014, IN-2018, MDD1-2012, MDD2-2018, MDD3-2019 and SCZ2-2014.

## Transcript level

### Diagnosis with normal model

First, run the linear model with correction for all covariates and generate the result table. 
```{r, echo = F}
# generate design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ Dx + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + SV1, pData)
# differential expression analysis (limma)
fit <- RunLimma(design, transcript_summaries)
# result table
top_hits <- GenerateResultTableTranscript(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file =  "1.1_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis.csv")
# volcano plot
GenerateVolcanoPlot(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file = "1.1_volcano_plot_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis.pdf")
```
No (`r length(top_hits[top_hits$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"])`) hits. Maybe a problem of the multiple testing correction as we have too many transcripts to correct for. We will test a new FDR correction model in the following section.

Get significantly differentially expressed transcripts for all the different covariates (corrected for all the other covariates). 
```{r, echo = F}
# generate vertical barplot
limma_res_transcript <- GenerateVerticalBarplotOfDiffExprHits(design, fit, from = 5, to = 4, plot_name = "1.1_barplot_significant_DEA_hits_transcripts.pdf")
rm(design, fit, top_hits)
```

### Diagnosis with recalculated p-values and FDR

As the low adjusted p-values of the transcript expressions could come from the high number of transcripts to test for, we want to redo the adjusted p-value calculation as followed:

1. Take the lowest p-value of all transcripts corresponding to a gene
2. Get all transcript IDs and reduce the expression Set to these transcripts
2. Calculate p-values and FDR using limma on the reduced transcript set
```{r, echo = F}
# reduce expression set
dim(transcript_summaries)
transcript_summaries_new <- GetExprWithSmallestP(input = "1.1_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis.csv", transcript_summaries)
dim(transcript_summaries_new)
# generate design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ Dx + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + SV1, pData)
# differential expression analysis (limma)
fit <- RunLimma(design, transcript_summaries_new)
# result table
top_hits <- GenerateResultTableTranscript(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file =  "1.3_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv")
top_hits_age <- GenerateResultTableTranscript(fit, variable = "Age", file =  "1.3_diff_expr_transcripts_for_age_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv")
top_hits_ph <- GenerateResultTableTranscript(fit, variable = "pH", file =  "1.3_diff_expr_transcripts_for_ph_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv")
top_hits_pmi <- GenerateResultTableTranscript(fit, variable = "PMI", file =  "1.3_diff_expr_transcripts_for_pmi_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv")
top_hits_c2 <- GenerateResultTableTranscript(fit, variable = "C2", file =  "1.3_diff_expr_transcripts_for_c2_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv")
top_hits_c1 <- GenerateResultTableTranscript(fit, variable = "C1", file =  "1.3_diff_expr_transcripts_for_c1_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv")
# volcano plot
GenerateVolcanoPlot(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file = "1.3_volcano_plot_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf")
```
Now, we have multiple hits on the transcript level. We can find `r length(top_hits[top_hits$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"])` hits for diagnosis, `r length(top_hits_age[top_hits_age$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"])` hits for age, `r length(top_hits_ph[top_hits_ph$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"])` hits for pH, `r length(top_hits_pmi[top_hits_pmi$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"])` hits for pmi, `r length(top_hits_c2[top_hits_c2$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"])` hits for the second ancestry principal component (PC2). All hits are based on a 10% FDR (FDR < 0.1). The six diagnosis gene hits are: `r top_hits[top_hits$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"]`

Get significantly differentially expressed transcripts for all the different covariates (corrected for all the other covariates). 
```{r, echo = F}
# generate vertical barplot
limma_res_transcript.new <- GenerateVerticalBarplotOfDiffExprHits(design, fit, from = 5, to = 4, plot_name = "1.3_barplot_significant_DEA_hits_transcripts_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf")
rm(design, fit)
```

Now, we generate some plots for the six found tDEGenes for diagnosis. First, we will plot a heatmap of the six tDEGenes.
```{r, echo = F}
# get only top hits (6 tDEGenes)
top_hits <- top_hits[top_hits$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, ]
# ǵenerate heatmap of hits
anno <- pData(transcript_summaries)[, c("Age", "PMI", "RIN", "Sex", "Suicide", "Dx", "ShortName")]
rownames(anno) <- anno$ShortName
anno$ShortName <- NULL
pheatmap(exprs(transcript_summaries)[top_hits$`Ensembl Transcript ID`, ], scale = "row", annotation_col = anno, show_colnames = F)
pheatmap(exprs(transcript_summaries)[top_hits$`Ensembl Transcript ID`, ], scale = "row", annotation_col = anno, show_colnames = F, filename = "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/04_figures/1.3_heatmap_significant_DEA_hits_transcripts_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf")
rm(anno)
```

Then, we plot the up and down regulated genes into one barplot with the two variables mirrored on the x-axis.
```{r, echo = F}
logfc <- as.data.frame(table(top_hits$logFC))
logfc$group <- "Upregulated"
logfc[as.numeric(as.character(logfc$Var1)) < 0, "group"] <- "Downregulated"
logfc[as.numeric(as.character(logfc$Var1)) < 0, "Freq"] <- -1
logfc$Var1 <- abs(round(as.numeric(as.character(logfc$Var1)), 2))
logfc$logfc <- 2^logfc$Var1
logfc$linearFC <- sapply(logfc$logfc, function(x) {if(as.double(as.character(x)) >= 1 || is.na(x)){x} else {-1/x}})
# generate barplot
ggplot(logfc, aes(x = linearFC, y = Freq, fill = group)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "identity", show.legend = FALSE) + 
  xlab("linear fold change") +
  ylab("# tDEGenes (FDR < 10%)") +
  xlim(1, 1.5) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(colour = "black"), axis.line.y.left = element_line(colour = "black"), axis.ticks.length = unit(.15, "cm"), axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black")) + 
  annotate("text", x = 1.4, y = 1.3, label = paste0("No. of genes upregulated: ", length(logfc[logfc$group == "Upregulated", "group"])), size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.4, y = -1.3, label = paste0("No. of genes downregulated: ", length(logfc[logfc$group == "Downregulated", "group"])), size = 4) + 
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = T, end = 0.8)
ggsave("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/04_figures/1.3_barplot_up_down_regulated_significant_DEA_hits_transcripts_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf", width = 5.43, height = 3.45, units = "in")
rm(logfc)
```

Now, we generate violin plots for all gene hits.
```{r, echo = F}
for (hit in top_hits$`Ensembl Transcript ID`) {
  name <- top_hits[hit, "Gene Symbol"]
  # get exprs of top hit
  data <- as.data.frame(exprs(transcript_summaries)[top_hits[hit, "Ensembl Transcript ID"], ])
  colnames(data) <- "expression"
  data <- merge(data, pData(transcript_summaries)[, c("ShortName", "Dx")], by.x = "row.names", by.y = "ShortName")
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Dx, y = expression, fill = Dx)) + 
    geom_violin() + 
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 20), plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
    labs(title = paste0(top_hits[hit, "Ensembl Gene ID"], ": ", top_hits[hit, "Gene Symbol"]), x = element_blank(), y = "Expression values") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Controls", "Cases")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = viridis(2, begin = 0.3, end = 0.9, option = "D"), guide = FALSE, name = "", labels = c("Controls", "Cases"))
  ggsave(paste0("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/04_figures/1.3_violinplot_significant_DEA_hits_transcripts_new_pvalue_and_fdr_", top_hits[hit, "Gene Symbol"],".pdf"), width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")
}
rm(name, data)
```

No (`r length(top_hits[top_hits$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"])`) hits. Maybe also a problem of the multiple testing correction as we have too many transcripts to correct for.

### PRS with recalculated p-value and FDR

As the low adjusted p-values of the transcript expressions could come from the high number of transcripts to test for, we want to redo the adjusted p-value calculation for all PRS from above as follows:

1. Take the lowest p-value of all transcripts corresponding to a gene
2. Get all transcript IDs and reduce the expression Set to these transcripts
2. Calculate p-values and FDR using limma on the reduced transcript set

**ADHD-2017 PRS**
```{r, echo = F}
# reduce expression set
transcript_summaries_new <- GetExprWithSmallestP(input = "2.1.1_diff_expr_transcripts_for_ADHD-2017_PRS.csv", transcript_summaries)
dim(transcript_summaries_new)
# generate design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ PRS.ADHD + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + SV1, pData)
# differential expression analysis (limma)
fit <- RunLimma(design, transcript_summaries_new)
# generate result table
top_hits <- GenerateResultTableTranscript(fit, variable = "PRS.ADHD", file =  "2.2.1_diff_expr_transcripts_for_ADHD-2017_PRS_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv")
# remove unnecessary data
rm(transcript_summaries_new, design, fit)
```
We can find `r length(top_hits[top_hits$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"])` hits for FDR < 10% (hits for FDR < 5%: `r length(top_hits[top_hits$"FDR estimate" < 0.05, "Ensembl Gene ID"])`) for the ADHD-2017 PRS.

## Exon level 

### Diagnosis with normal model

First, run the linear model with correction for all covariates and generate the result table. 
```{r, echo = F}
# generate design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ Dx + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + SV1, pData)
# differential expression analysis (limma)
fit <- RunLimma(design, exon_summaries)
# result table
top_hits <- GenerateResultTableExon(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file =  "1.1_diff_expr_exons_for_diagnosis.csv")
# volcano plot
GenerateVolcanoPlot(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file = "1.1_volcano_plot_diff_expr_exons_for_diagnosis.pdf")
```
We can find `r length(top_hits[top_hits$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"])` hits for diagnosis. Maybe it is a multiple testing correction problem as we have a lot of exons (around 200,000). 

Get significantly differentially expressed genes for all the different covariates. 
```{r, echo = F}
# generate vertical barplot
limma_res_exon <- GenerateVerticalBarplotOfDiffExprHits(design, fit, from = 6, to = 5, plot_name = "1.1_barplot_significant_DEA_hits_exons.pdf")
```

Now, we combine the barplot of the number of differentially expressed genes, transcripts and exons per covariate (corrected for all other covariates). 
```{r, echo = F}
### ALL COMBINED (gene + transcript + exon barplot) ###
colnames(limma_res_gene) <- "counts"
limma_res_gene$type <- "gene"
limma_res_gene$covariates <- row.names(limma_res_gene)
colnames(limma_res_transcript) <- "counts"
limma_res_transcript$type <- "transcript"
limma_res_transcript$covariates <- row.names(limma_res_transcript)
colnames(limma_res_exon) <- "counts"
limma_res_exon$type <- "exon"
limma_res_exon$covariates <- row.names(limma_res_exon)
limma.res.all <- rbind(limma_res_gene, limma_res_transcript, limma_res_exon)
limma.res.all$covariates <- as.factor(limma.res.all$covariates)
limma.res.all$covariates <- factor(limma.res.all$covariates, levels = c("C4", "C3", "C2", "C1", "Type_of_Death","Suicide", "Sex", "RIN2", "RIN", "Diagnosis", "PMI", "pH", "Age"))
# save plot
pdf("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/04_figures/1.1_barplots_significant_DEA_hits_gene_transcript_exon_combined.pdf")
p <- ggplot(limma.res.all, aes(y = counts, x = covariates)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() + 
  theme(axis.ticks = element_line(colour = NA), text = element_text(size = 22), panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA), panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey"), panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(colour = "grey"), strip.background =element_rect(fill = NA)) +
  ylab("# significant hits") +
  xlab("") +
  geom_text(size = 7, aes(label = limma.res.all$counts), nudge_y = 120, colour = "dimgray") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.01))
p + facet_wrap(~ type, scale = "free_x") + theme(panel.spacing = unit(2, "lines"))
dev.off()
# remove unnecessary data
rm(design, fit, top_hits, limma_res_exon, limma_res_transcript, limma.res.all, p)
```

### Diagnosis with sex and diagnosis interaction model

Adding a Sex and diagnosis interaction term (Sex * Dx) to the model.
```{r, echo = F}
# generate design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ Dx + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + SV1 + (Sex*Dx), pData)
# differential expression analysis (limma)
fit <- RunLimma(design, exon_summaries)
# result table
top_hits <- GenerateResultTableExon(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file =  "1.2_diff_expr_exons_for_diagnosis_with_sex_dx_interaction.csv")
# volcano plot
GenerateVolcanoPlot(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file = "1.2_volcano_plot_diff_expr_exons_for_diagnosis_with_sex_dx_interaction.pdf")
# remove unnecessary data
rm(design, fit)
```
No `r length(top_hits[top_hits$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"])` hits. Maybe also a problem of the multiple testing correction.

### Diagnosis with recalculated p-values and FDR

As the low adjusted p-values of the transcript expressions could come from the high number of transcripts to test for, we want to redo the adjusted p-value calculation as followed:

1. Take the lowest p-value of all transcripts corresponding to a gene
2. Get all transcript IDs and reduce the expression Set to these transcripts
2. Calculate p-values and FDR using limma on the reduced transcript set
```{r, echo = F}
# reduce expression set
dim(exon_summaries)
exon_summaries_new <- GetExprWithSmallestP(input = "1.1_diff_expr_exons_for_diagnosis.csv", exon_summaries)
dim(exon_summaries_new)
# generate design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ Dx + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + SV1, pData)
# differential expression analysis (limma)
fit <- RunLimma(design, exon_summaries_new)
# result table
top_hits <- GenerateResultTableExon(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file =  "1.3_diff_expr_exons_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv")
top_hits_age <- GenerateResultTableExon(fit, variable = "Age", file =  "1.3_diff_expr_exons_for_age_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv")
top_hits_ph <- GenerateResultTableExon(fit, variable = "pH", file =  "1.3_diff_expr_exons_for_ph_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv")
top_hits_pmi <- GenerateResultTableExon(fit, variable = "PMI", file =  "1.3_diff_expr_exons_for_pmi_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv")
top_hits_c2 <- GenerateResultTableExon(fit, variable = "C2", file =  "1.3_diff_expr_exons_for_c2_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv")
top_hits_c1 <- GenerateResultTableExon(fit, variable = "C1", file =  "1.3_diff_expr_exons_for_c1_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv")
# volcano plot
GenerateVolcanoPlot(fit, variable = "DxCASE", file = "1.3_volcano_plot_diff_expr_exons_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf")
```
Now, we have multiple hits on the exon level. We can find `r length(top_hits[top_hits$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"])` hits for diagnosis, `r length(top_hits_age[top_hits_age$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"])` hits for age, `r length(top_hits_ph[top_hits_ph$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"])` hits for pH, `r length(top_hits_pmi[top_hits_pmi$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"])` hits for pmi, `r length(top_hits_c2[top_hits_c2$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"])` hits for the second ancestry principal component (PC2). All hits are based on a 10% FDR (FDR < 0.1). The first ten diagnosis gene hits are: `r top_hits[top_hits$"FDR estimate" < 0.1, "Ensembl Gene ID"][1:10]`

Get significantly differentially expressed genes for all the different covariates. 
```{r, echo = F}
# generate vertical barplot
limma_res_exon.new <- GenerateVerticalBarplotOfDiffExprHits(design, fit, from = 6, to = 5, plot_name = "1.3_barplot_significant_DEA_hits_exons_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf")
```

Now, we combine the barplot of the number of differentially expressed genes, transcripts and exons per covariate (corrected for all other covariates). 
```{r, echo = F}
### ALL COMBINED (gene + transcript + exon barplot) ###
colnames(limma_res_transcript.new) <- "counts"
limma_res_transcript.new$type <- "transcript"
limma_res_transcript.new$covariates <- row.names(limma_res_transcript.new)
colnames(limma_res_exon.new) <- "counts"
limma_res_exon.new$type <- "exon"
limma_res_exon.new$covariates <- row.names(limma_res_exon.new)
limma.res.all <- rbind(limma_res_gene, limma_res_transcript.new, limma_res_exon.new)
limma.res.all$covariates <- as.factor(limma.res.all$covariates)
limma.res.all$covariates <- factor(limma.res.all$covariates, levels = c("C4", "C3", "C2", "C1", "Type_of_Death","Suicide", "Sex", "RIN2", "RIN", "Diagnosis", "PMI", "pH", "Age"))
# save plot
pdf("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/04_figures/1.3_barplots_significant_DEA_hits_gene_transcript_exon_combined_new_pvalues_and_fdr.pdf")
p <- ggplot(limma.res.all, aes(y = counts, x = covariates)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() + 
  theme(axis.ticks = element_line(colour = NA), text = element_text(size = 22), panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA), panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey"), panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(colour = "grey"), strip.background =element_rect(fill = NA)) +
  ylab("# significant hits") +
  xlab("") +
  geom_text(size = 7, aes(label = limma.res.all$counts), nudge_y = 120, colour = "dimgray") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.01))
p + facet_wrap(~ type, scale = "free_x") + theme(panel.spacing = unit(2, "lines"))
dev.off()
# remove unnecessary data
rm(design, fit, limma_res_exon.new, limma_res_transcript.new, limma_res_gene, limma.res.all, p)
```

Now we generate some plots for the found eDEgenes. First, we will plot a heatmap of the 2224 eDEGenes.
```{r, echo = F}
# get only top hits (2224 eDEGenes)
top_hits <- top_hits[top_hits$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, ]
# ǵenerate heatmap of hits
anno <- pData(exon_summaries)[, c("Age", "PMI", "RIN", "Sex", "Suicide", "Dx", "ShortName")]
rownames(anno) <- anno$ShortName
anno$ShortName <- NULL
pheatmap(exprs(exon_summaries)[top_hits$`Ensembl Exon ID`, ], scale = "row", annotation_col = anno, show_colnames = F, show_rownames = F)
pheatmap(exprs(exon_summaries)[top_hits$`Ensembl Exon ID`, ], scale = "row", annotation_col = anno, show_colnames = F, show_rownames = F, filename = "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/04_figures/1.3_heatmap_significant_DEA_hits_exons_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf")
rm(anno)
```

Then, we plot the up and down regulated genes into one barplot with the two variables mirrored on the x-axis.
```{r, echo = F}
logfc <- as.data.frame(table(top_hits$logFC))
logfc$group <- "Upregulated"
logfc[as.numeric(as.character(logfc$Var1)) < 0, "group"] <- "Downregulated"
logfc[as.numeric(as.character(logfc$Var1)) < 0, "Freq"] <- -1
logfc$Var1 <- abs(round(as.numeric(as.character(logfc$Var1)), 2))
logfc$logfc <- 2^logfc$Var1
logfc$linearFC <- sapply(logfc$logfc, function(x) {if(as.double(as.character(x)) >= 1 || is.na(x)){x} else {-1/x}})
min(logfc$linearFC)
max(logfc$linearFC)
mean(logfc$linearFC)
ggplot(logfc, aes(x = linearFC, y = Freq, fill = group)) + 
  geom_histogram(stat = "identity", show.legend = FALSE) + 
  xlab("Linear fold change") +
  ylab("# tDEGenes (FDR < 10%)") +
  xlim(1, 1.8) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(colour = "black"), axis.line.y.left = element_line(colour = "black"), axis.ticks.length = unit(.15, "cm"), axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black")) + 
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 30, label = paste0("No. of genes upregulated: ", length(logfc[logfc$group == "Upregulated", "group"])), size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = -30, label = paste0("No. of genes downregulated: ", length(logfc[logfc$group == "Downregulated", "group"])), size = 4) + 
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = T, end = 0.8)
ggsave("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/04_figures/1.3_barplot_up_down_regulated_significant_DEA_hits_exons_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf", width = 5.43, height = 3.45, units = "in")
rm(logfc)
```

Now, we generate violin plots for the top six hits.
```{r, echo = F}
for (hit in top_hits$`Ensembl Exon ID`[1:6]) {
  name <- top_hits[hit, "Gene Symbol"]
  # get exprs of top hit
  data <- as.data.frame(exprs(exon_summaries)[top_hits[hit, "Ensembl Exon ID"], ])
  colnames(data) <- "expression"
  data <- merge(data, pData(exon_summaries)[, c("ShortName", "Dx")], by.x = "row.names", by.y = "ShortName")
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Dx, y = expression, fill = Dx)) + 
    geom_violin() + 
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 20), plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
    labs(title = top_hits[hit, "Gene Symbol"], x = element_blank(), y = "Expression values") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Controls", "Cases")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = viridis(2, begin = 0.3, end = 0.9, option = "D"), guide = FALSE, name = "", labels = c("Controls", "Cases"))
  ggsave(paste0("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/04_figures/1.3_violinplot_significant_DEA_hits_exons_new_pvalue_and_fdr_", top_hits[hit, "Gene Symbol"],".pdf"), width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")
}
rm(name, data)
```
